policy.pricing_text: FRAs at the 15 Jan close (1x4 3.84, 3x6 3.57, 6x9 3.42, 9x12 3.41 vs WIBOR 3M 3.94) price roughly 55bp of NBP cuts within 12 months. The MPC held at 4.00% on 14 Jan. Glapiński (15 Jan): a terminal rate of about 3.5% with a real rate of at least 1-1.5%, cuts in 25bp steps; he excluded neither February nor March (or even April). Post-conference (15 Jan): ING sees the next cut in March and 3.25% by end-2026; BNP two cuts to 3.50%; Bank Pocztowy says investors started pricing February. December final CPI confirmed 2.4% y/y (15 Jan).
policy.risk_text: February is now debated inside the MPC (Glapiński excluded neither February nor March): if the cut slips beyond March the front-end roll-down does not materialise, and global long-end volatility (tariffs, Fed independence) hits the 10Y through the asset swap.

cpi.m: Dec final (GUS, 15 Jan); Nov 2.5%; Nov core 2.7%

macro.projection_text: NBP November 2025 projection: CPI 3.7% (2025), 2.9% (2026), 2.5% (2027); December 2025 CPI 2.4% y/y (final). The March 2026 projection is due with the March MPC meeting.
macro.fiscal_text: 2025 general-government deficit ~7.0% of GDP; 2026 budget deficit cap PLN 271.7bn, gross borrowing needs ~PLN 690bn; the 2026 budget awaited the President's signature.
macro.fiscal_risk_text: Q1 2026 supply of PLN 75-100bn over 8 auctions; 2026 needs ~26% financed (12 Jan); Fitch (27 Feb) and Moody's (20 Mar) reviews with negative outlooks.
macro.backdrop_text: The NBP cut six times in 2025 to 4.00% and held on 14 Jan; December CPI 2.4% y/y (final, 15 Jan); the NBP projects 2.9% for 2026 (professional forecasters 2.6%); the March projection is the next policy gate. GDP grew 3.8% y/y in Q3. Ratings: Fitch A- negative, Moody's A2 negative, S&P A- stable. 15 Jan: Glapiński's press conference pushed short-end POLGB yields lower in the afternoon and investors started pricing a February cut (Bank Pocztowy, PAP close). Abroad: US jobless claims 198k, Philly Fed 12.6; Brent fell 4.6% to ~$63 as Iran-strike fears eased; Fitch warned of European downgrades if the Greenland dispute splits NATO.

calendar.plan_text: MoF Q1 2026 financing plan (31 Dec 2025): 8 sale auctions for PLN 75-100bn, one switch auction, possible foreign issuance; January sales 9 Jan (done: PLN 13.7bn incl. additional sale), 22 Jan (plan 8-13bn) and 28 Jan (7-12bn); EUR 3.25bn priced on 8 Jan.
calendar.timing_text: Within each auction week of the Aug 2025-Jan 2026 sample, yields drifted lower into the auction (rally regime) and the auction-day close was the cheapest point relative to the preceding session, so new buying is best executed at the auction-day close (22 and 28 Jan) rather than the day before. The 9 Jan auction cleared PLN 13.7bn with 1.86x cover. For the front end the 3-4 Feb MPC is the next event: February is debated after Glapiński's dovish conference; the March projection decides the cut timing.

facts.core_policy_note: Real rate = policy rate − latest CPI. Fed rate = midpoint of the range. Sources: ECB key-rates page; Fed press release 10 Dec 2025 and SEP; BoE Monetary Policy Summary Dec 2025; CNB press release 18 Dec 2025; MNB press release 16 Dec 2025; NBP/MPC 3 Dec 2025; CPI releases (Eurostat 17 Dec, Destatis 12 Dec, BLS 18 Dec, ONS 17 Dec, CZSO 10 Dec, MNB 16 Dec, INS 12 Dec, GUS 31 Dec). Later releases used where published by the info cut-off: GUS 15 Jan, Eurostat 7 Jan, CZSO 13 Jan, KSH 13 Jan, BLS 13 Jan.
facts.core_text: Regime: the NBP paused at 4.00% with ~55bp more priced, the ECB is done at 2.00% (a hike is the next move in market pricing), the Fed is on hold into June, the BoE eases gradually, the CNB and MNB are on hold. (Erste's CDS/spread table for 15 Jan looked stale or inconsistent, so it is not quoted.) UST 10Y 4.16%, Bund 2.82% (15 Jan).

quasi_takeaways: FPC fixed lines trade ~{lo}-{hi}bp over the POLGB curve (average {avg}bp); widest ASW {widest} at {widest_asw}bp. Same State Treasury guarantee as POLGBs.
Best pickup: {best} ({best_sp}bp vs POLGB). For buy-and-hold books the guarantee makes the pickup attractive; liquidity is the cost (Pekao became BGK market maker on 13 Nov 2025).

12 Jan BGK auction: PLN 3.73bn sold against 7.05bn demand, plus 0.71bn in the additional sale (~PLN 4.4bn, about a quarter of the 2026 FPC plan of up to 18.5bn); per-series levels were not found. The 1.9x cover shows real-money demand for guaranteed paper at these spreads.
Use auctions, not Catalyst: trades are small retail lots and some lines go weeks without a print.
